styles.b: Handmade plasticine claymation scene, everything sculpted from smooth modelling clay with soft fingerprint texture, chunky rounded shapes, bright cheerful colours, soft studio light.

pictures.name: robin-wait
pictures.prompt: Robin, a cute round New Zealand robin with a grey-black head, a bright yellow-cream chest and thin legs, sitting upright and looking friendly. Single object, centred, the whole object visible with space around it, on a plain pure white background, clean empty white all around. Suitable for young children aged 5 to 7.
